nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the chosen photo of this birthday dinner, taken from the main camera at the foot of the table with everyone in their own chair: edit this photo. Image 2 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 3 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 4 is the son's wife's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, hair and dinner outfit. Image 5 shows the brochure: use it only for its size and cover. Keep exactly as in Image 1: the room, the camera position and its direction, the light, the table setting, and every person's face, hair and clothes; everyone who sits stays in their own chair from Image 1, and nobody new appears. Change only the framing, the moment, the actions and the expressions described here. The camera stays where it is and zooms in: the framing is much tighter than Image 1, as described. Medium shot. The photo shows the same dining room from the same camera, zoomed in on the head end of the room: the grandmother is not in the room yet and her own chair at the head of the table stands empty; the son has left his chair and stands at the sideboard beyond his wife's chair, turned in profile toward it, his hand sliding the brochure under the gold gift bag with pink tissue paper, the cover facing up and readable; his daughter has followed him and stands just behind his shoulder, turned three-quarters toward the camera, stunned, looking at what he is doing; the son's wife sits in her chair at the lower right edge of the frame, out of focus, looking at the table. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a navy quarter-zip pullover and chinos. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a plain grey hoodie with no logo and leggings. The son's wife: a 44-year-old Black American woman with light-medium brown skin and natural hair in a neat high bun. She wears the same dinner outfit as in her character sheet. The brochure is a glossy senior-living brochure whose cover photo shows smiling seniors at a communal dining table. This shot shows only part of the dinner: everyone not described here is out of the frame, and nobody else is in the room. Other dishes on the table, soft: collard greens, candied sweet potatoes and cornbread. No birthday cake on the table yet. The birthday gifts stand only on the sideboard: the same three gift bags with tissue paper as in Image 1 (a gold one with pink tissue, a light-blue one and a pink patterned one) and a small crystal dish; there are no gifts on the table. Expressions true to this moment: the son furtive and guilty, his jaw set; his daughter stunned and hurt for her grandmother, her eyes wide; nobody smiles; natural and believable, never exaggerated or posed. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids; the son's wife is the same woman as in her character sheet. No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays; the brochure cover lettering "WRENFIELD · SENIOR LIVING" stays.
